periods.location: Fukuoka graveyard overlooking Wakaba House district
periods.summary: Toka confronts Harima Tendo after he reveals himself as Daien and the Tendoshu leader. Tendo summons Ame-no-Murakumo, explains his divine grace doctrine, and demonstrates an intangible spirit-like body born from Excessive Awakening. Toka's Raikiri and repeated attacks cannot touch him. He creates massive thunderclouds and rains lightning on the town below to force Toka into despair and Awakening.
periods.cause: Toka is alone with Tendo when League Japan's warning arrives too late; Tendo chooses her as a candidate to receive his so-called grace.
periods.process: Toka initially believes lightning affinity and sword skill give her a chance. Tendo reveals that his power is not simply lightning and that his body can turn into cloudlike magical spirit. He unleashes Houten Banrai on the surrounding city while embracing and comforting Toka with sincere but deranged affection.
periods.outcome: Toka collapses emotionally, unable to protect Wakaba House or the town. Misogi arrives and is nearly burned by Bansho Kaijin before Moroboshi intervenes.
periods.significance: Reveals Tendo's ideology, his disaster-scale abilities, and the psychological wound that drives Toka's later arc.
